note: Nelson County (VA) publishes no queryable zoning district service. Its GIS is the CivQuest web viewer at nelsoncountygis.org (not an ArcGIS REST service; /arcgis/rest/services returns 404), and the county zoning page links only the ordinance text and the GIS viewer. A Dec 2025 work-session memo says the official Zoning Map is being updated with a possible future online GIS version. No incorporated towns exist in the county to publish their own zoning. ArcGIS searches for Nelson zoning found only parcels and unrelated layers.
